scoring.bounded_verified: Earn full criterion weight for a distinct narrow demonstrated behavior with linked merged code-and-test evidence; never implies release-gate acceptance
scoring.regressed: Earn no points and retain prior receipt history

review_policy: Initial marked bounded_verified criteria inherit linked merged PR evidence but require independent source review before treating as audited; no claim of release gate acceptance. Provisional bounded_coverage must be distinguished from independently_audited_coverage (zero pending explicit audit_state=independent_reviewed).
